description: Prices and explains Cheap NY Publication's other New York LLC filings, all in with the state fee: the Biennial Statement (New York's every-two-years report; there is no annual report), a Certificate of Good Standing (Certificate of Status), a DBA (Certificate of Assumed Name) for an LLC, and a county change (Certificate of Change). The Biennial Statement and the Certificate of Good Standing are for business corporations too. For a Biennial Statement, pass the company's filing date to get the month it is due. Use for any of these four.

assumed_name.description: DBA only: the name to trade under, to check it is allowed.

filing_date.description: Biennial only: the LLC's or corporation's original filing date (YYYY-MM-DD), to find the due month.
